svg.text: Generation ZX Developers
GenAI Startup Edition
In 2018 I wrote Generation Z Developers for one reader: the
generation entering the job market. Eight years later that
generation is not only looking for jobs. They are starting
companies. And so is mine.
This is version 2, and it is written for two generations.
Generation Z, entering the workforce and becoming the new
entrepreneurs. And Generation X: the subject-matter experts,
twenty years inside a problem, who can now build the first
version of the answer themselves, with agents, instead of
explaining it to a team they could never afford. Often they are in
the same family. Put the two letters together and you get
Generation ZX, which takes me back to where I started: the ZX
Spectrum.
The book has one objective: that by the end of it, you
have started a company.
I measure this book by how many companies are created
from it. If you start one, tell me.
Dinis Cruz
Built in public at gen-z-developers.sgit.ai
